response.overview: A grain of beans is everything for a day's meal. This is a fasting center. Ji-hyun, who is despised by the students for her rumbling sound every day, just wants to live quietly. Whether or not, life is always twisted. One day, when I met Papillon Sua of the fasting center, my comfortable life began to run like a roller coaster. Escape this place? How on earth?
response.title: Oh My Happy Diet
